jobs.title: Product Manager, Interoperability
jobs.description:
At project44, we believe in better.

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn’t just possible—it’s essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world.

With our Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement , we’re redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.

If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

AI at project44

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers.

If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

About the Role

We're hiring a Product Manager, Interoperability to define how project44 connects to the systems our customers, logistics service providers, and partners run - which systems we ingest data from, which systems we egress to, and the business rules that govern the workflow between them. This role owns the process design, not just the requirements handoff: mapping as-is and to-be workflows, defining the system-to-system data flow for each integration pattern, and setting the success metrics that determine whether a given interoperability solution actually works for the business, with the goal of creating packaged integration solutions that are ready to go to market, as well as decrease time to value for Project44 customers.

What You'll Do

- Understand project44’s ICP and their Supply Chain Systems of record, and our customers’ needs to integrate to those solutions. Additionally, understand adjacent solutions and data sources and how our customers use those to fuel their supply chain solutions.

- Define and document system-to-system workflows - which source systems we ingest from (Supply / Demand Planning, ERP, TMS/WMS, EDI/API feeds) and which destination systems we egress to (Supply Chain Planning systems, partner systems, cloud Datawarehouse systems), including sequencing the work and business rules

- Write business design documents, PRD’s, design specs and any documentation necessary to communicate system integrations and data types need to support required workflows.

- Own business process design for interoperability: map as-is and to-be workflows for scenarios like order-to-cash, Transportation Planning and Execution, and Supply and Demand Planning lifecycles, exception handling, and translate them into structured system-to-system data flows

- Understand fundamentals of MCP interoperability and where it’s used – and how system to system interoperability goals can be met between LLM’s

- Define the success metrics and acceptance criteria for each workflow or integration pattern before build begins, and own whether those metrics are actually met post-launch

- Act as the source of truth for interoperability workflow definitions - what data moves, between which systems, under what conditions - resolving ambiguity before it reaches Engineering

- Run structured discovery with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders (Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering) to capture current-state process gaps and target-state workflow designs

- Partner with Data/Platform Engineering to validate that workflow designs are compatible with cloud data warehouse ingestion and transformation patterns (Snowflake, Databricks)

- Prioritize and sequence workflow design work across the interoperability roadmap, balancing one-off customer requests against scalable, reusable process patterns

- Write clear, unambiguous workflow and requirements documentation that Engineering can build against without re-litigating the business process

What You'll Bring

- 5–8 years in business process design, business/systems analysis, or product management with a focus on system-to-system integrations

- Demonstrated experience mapping and documenting business process workflows across multiple systems (process mapping, workflow diagrams, BPMN or equivalent)

- Strong fluency in API and MCP concepts and data transformation patterns - enough to define workflows credibly and partner with Engineering on feasibility; hands-on API build experience is not required

- Working familiarity with cloud data warehouse platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, or similar) and how data moves through ingestion, transformation, and egress

- Track record of defining success metrics and acceptance criteria for complex, cross-system initiatives — not just executing against metrics someone else set

- Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills; able to run structured discovery sessions with customers, partners, and internal teams and drive them to a decision

- Supply chain, logistics, or complex B2B SaaS platform experience is a plus, not required

Success Metrics — First 12 Months

- Documented, source-of-truth workflow definitions (ingress/egress maps) published for the top integration patterns across the interoperability portfolio

- A standard framework for defining success metrics and acceptance criteria adopted across all new interoperability initiatives

- Reduction in Engineering rework attributable to incomplete or ambiguous process definitions

- Positive feedback from Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success on the clarity of workflow specs prior to build

Work from office expectations: This role requires you to operate from office all 5 days in a week.

Diversity & Inclusion:

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email heena.mehta@project44.com . Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

More about project44:

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

jobs.description:

With our Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement , we’re redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.
Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.

AI at project44

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers.

If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

In-office Commitment: Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. We are looking for candidates who are enthusiastic and committed to joining our team on-site, in our beautiful headquarters four days a week. Together, we’re building something extraordinarily learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

About the role

Movement is the platform underneath everything project44 ships: visibility, analytics, AI agents, and a growing set of modules (Appointment Manager, Yard, Last Mile) being migrated onto it as a shared foundation. We're hiring a Senior Platform Product Manager to own both halves of that foundation: the technical platform capabilities that power Movement — identity and access, Collaborative Visibility, Search — and the user experience built on top of them. This is the connective tissue that makes Movement feel like one coherent product instead of a collection of features — the experience layer every persona depends on, the analytics customers see every day, and the security guarantees enterprise customers require before they'll trust us with sensitive freight data.

You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Design, Engineering, and Security — partnering closely with the pillar PMs who own individual modes and modules, while owning the platform primitives all of them build on. The role is deliberately dual-track: deep technical partnership with Engineering on the capabilities beneath the surface, and close partnership with Product Design on the experience above it.

What you'll do

Movement UX & platform evolution

- Own the product vision for how Movement's core experience evolves — the Overview dashboard, navigation, and shared UI patterns that other modules inherit as they migrate onto the platform

- Partner directly with Product Design on UX vision and prototypes, translating design principles into a sequenced, buildable roadmap

- Arbitrate platform-level UX trade-offs across pillar teams so Movement doesn't fragment into inconsistent experiences as more products move onto it

- Own the web, responsive, and mobile app strategy for Movement — deciding what belongs on web versus mobile, how responsive breakpoints serve users, and driving that plan through to implementation with Design and Engineering

Identity & access management

- Own the roadmap for Movement's IAM layer: tenant and user permissioning, Access Groups, role definitions, and the unified authorization model that lets us bring new products and acquisitions onto one identity system instead of bespoke ones

- Define and prioritize new permission models (e.g., restricted-visibility roles for security-sensitive customers) in partnership with Engineering and Security

- Be the product point of contact for IAM scoping on new acquisitions and partner integrations

Shared platform capabilities

- Own the product roadmap for Collaborative Visibility — how shippers, carriers, and partners share shipment data across tenant boundaries, and what each party is permitted to see

- Own Search as a platform capability: a consistent, performant way to find shipments, orders, locations, and documents across every module on Movement

- Work directly with platform engineering on the technical trade-offs behind these capabilities — data models, APIs, and performance — and translate them into a sequenced roadmap the pillar teams can build against

Persona-based experiences

- Take Movement from a one-size-fits-all Overview to persona-aware experiences for operators/planners, managers, and executives, building on validated discovery already in hand

- Define what's configurable versus persona-default, and how personalization scales without fragmenting the core platform

- Partner with Data/Analytics to use behavioral data — not just stated preference — to keep refining personas post-launch

Customer-facing analytics

- Own the platform-level strategy for analytics embedded in Movement: the shared infrastructure and experience layer, distinct from the mode-specific analytics content pillar PMs already own

- Lead build-vs-buy and vendor decisions for embedded analytics/BI

- Define self-service and platform-value reporting that cuts manual reporting work for Customer Success and gives customers direct visibility into adoption and ROI

Security & data governance

- Own security and data-exposure requirements across Movement's UI and APIs — field-level redaction, need-to-know access patterns, and audit logging for regulated or security-sensitive customers

- Partner with Security/Privacy and Engineering to turn customer security requirements into shippable, testable product requirements rather than one-off exceptions

- Represent Product in compliance-adjacent conversations (e.g., SOC 2, customer security reviews) where platform behavior is in scope

Cross-functional leadership

- Be the accountable owner that Sales, CX, Support, and Engineering escalate to on platform-level Movement questions

- Represent Platform in quarterly planning, RICE-based prioritization, and roadmap reviews alongside pillar PMs

- Write clear PRDs, product briefs, and decision docs — this org runs on Confluence and Jira Product Discovery as the system of record, not Slack threads

In your first 90 days, expect to: get current on the two or three enterprise-committed platform requests already in flight, ship (or make the call not to ship) the first phase of persona-based experiences, and stand up a clear owner-of-record model for embedded analytics — including a recommendation on our current BI vendor relationship.

What you'll bring

- 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time owning platform, identity/access, or infrastructure-adjacent surfaces — not only customer-facing features

- Working knowledge of IAM concepts (roles, permissions, tenancy, authorization) deep enough to have real trade-off conversations with engineering

- Range across both technical platform work and user experience — credible with engineering on data models, APIs, and search performance, and a real partner to Design on UX vision and prototypes

- A track record of shipping analytics or reporting products, ideally including vendor or build-vs-buy decisions for embedded BI

- Experience designing for multiple personas within one product, with the configurability-vs-complexity trade-off made explicit rather than assumed

- Comfort operating in ambiguity — this charter has been informally covered by several people, and you'll need to define its edges as much as execute inside them

- Clear, direct writing — PRDs and briefs a busy exec can read in five minutes and act on

- Enterprise B2B SaaS experience; supply chain, logistics, or another data-intensive vertical platform is a strong plus

Nice to have

- Experience integrating an acquired company's users and data onto a unified platform and permissions model

- Familiarity with freight/logistics security requirements (cargo visibility restrictions, data-sharing constraints) or equivalent regulated-data experience

- Experience evaluating or migrating embedded analytics/BI vendors

-

- In-office Commitment: Employees are expected to contribute to our collaborative culture by working in the office FOUR days weekly

Compensation and Benefits:

We continually evaluate our pay ranges to reflect skills, experience, and market conditions. The base salary offered will be determined by assessing a candidate's experience and skills relative to the scope and responsibilities of the position, as well as the specific geographic location where the job will be performed. Base salary is one component of project44's total compensation package, which also includes stock options for all EOR and project44-employed team members, bonus or commission eligibility depending on role, and a benefits package tailored to your country of employment. Specific benefits package offerings vary by country and may include health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, and paid time off, in line with local market standards and statutory programs. The base salary range for this position is $165,000– $240,000 USD.

Diversity & Inclusion

We’re designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. We can only deliver a truly world-class product and experience if our teams are as diverse and unique as the communities we are building for. It’s up to us to create a company where anyone can bring their authentic self to work every day. We’re constantly working to improve, and we accept our responsibility to elevate the voices left in the margins. It’s on every one of us.

Our focus on inclusion manifests in the way we hire, the customers we serve, and the regions we prioritize. We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for: a company that celebrates you for being you.

We pride ourselves on celebrating everyone — project44 is an equal opportunity employer actively working on creating a diverse and inclusive work environment where underrepresented groups can thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

For any accommodations needed during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44.com. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying.
